sections: The Part II overhaul moves character progression toward equipment slots rather than individual equipment pieces. This is an unofficial English summary of the Korean developer notice.
Four new equipment types are introduced: Bracer, Belt, Artifact and Seal. Accessories become part of the main equipment progression system.

Existing equipment converts automatically. Some high-end pieces receive additional item levels. The examples apply to individual weapons and armor pieces, not the character average. Sidereal weapons have separate rules.

Quality compensation is based on the highest eligible quality equipment owned for each weapon and armor slot. Sidereal weapons are excluded from standard quality compensation. Existing Artisan’s Energy carries over to its corresponding slot. Exact exchange rates remain unverified.
Sidereal weapons have separate item-level conversion and material refund rules. Refunded materials are described as character-bound. Selected examples only.

Qualifying accessories receive Magic Infusion Scrolls in six grades; existing trade limits are preserved. H, M and L mean high, medium and low effect rolls. Only the best qualifying bracelet per character produces a Seal Infusion Scroll (grades 1–21). Remaining bracelets become dismantling materials; T3 bracelets are deleted. Qualifying Relic support necklaces and rings with H/H were summarized as grade 5. Exact eligibility needs verification.

Ability stones are removed and replaced with engraving-slot upgrades. Relic becomes the base engraving rarity. The conversion uses effective activation points, not raw faceting numbers. Both positive engravings must qualify for the character’s permitted DPS or support combinations. Negative effects do not affect conversion. A 4+4 stone also grants extra items.

Tradable gems become roster-shared, with simultaneous use by multiple characters. Character-bound gems remain restricted. A new higher-tier gem, provisionally called Celestial Gem, is introduced above T4 level 10. Three T4 level 10 gems make the first Celestial gem, then two same-level gems make the next level. Maximum level is not specified. Important exception: qualifying T4 level 8 Gems of Brilliance obtained through previous paid growth events/products or Paradise content are converted into a selection box instead of the standard same-level conversion. Choose one new non-tradable T4 level 8 gem or one new tradable T4 level 7 gem. Choosing the tradable level 7 option allows you to trade it or use it for gem fusion. This exception applies only to gems from the specified acquisition routes, not every level 8 gem.

Proficiency increases damage and allied attack-power buffs. Combat stats become freely assignable through Ark Passive, which unlocks at combat level 50. Cards no longer need to be manually equipped; similar effects do not stack and the strongest applies.
After all six designated characters have earned their weekly gold rewards, additional characters can earn character-bound gold from endgame content.

Life skills, sailing, stronghold, pets, and the player economy are being simplified. Direct player-to-player item trading uses a trust system, with additional Pheon fees possible for insufficient trust.
12. What to do before Part II launches

These eight preparation actions are carried over from the earlier English summary. Verify each against the official notice before spending materials or making irreversible decisions. Checklist progress is stored on your own device.
Interpretation, not an official promise. The overall direction appears to be consolidating character power into slots and reducing the cost and complexity of maintaining alts.
Shared gems and additional bound gold
New potentially expensive gem progression ceiling

Fuse T3 level 1–2 gems to at least level 3
Use Aura of Resonance recovery potions

balance.description: Expanded English reference for the November 18 KR live-server patch, including November 19 corrections. Based on accessible Korean patch-note reposts, reporting and class-specific cross-checks. Maxroll’s November 2026 guide is linked for additional detail but could not be directly accessed for a line-by-line comparison. Selected changes; not a guaranteed exhaustive translation. Western release timing and implementation may differ.
sources: Maxroll November 2026 balance guide (further reading; not directly accessible during review)
Korean patch repost – Scrapper and Glaivier
Community comparison of datamined vs live changes (cross-check)
systems: Multi-crit
Crit rate over 100% can trigger an additional critical damage increment. On-crit effects still trigger once per hit.
High-crit effects
Selected tripods and Ark Grid effects adjusted to accommodate multi-crit.
Blunt Thorn (rank 1 / 2)
Evolution damage 7.5% / 15% → 9.5% / 19%; excess-crit conversion coefficient 125% / 150% → 120% / 140%; previous maximum bonus caps removed.
Multi-crit exceptions
Blunt Thorn keeps its 80% crit limit and converts excess crit to Evolution damage instead; multi-crit also does not occur in Paradise content.
Combat analysis
Character details display crit rates over 100%; combat analysis now tracks multi-crit hit rate and share of damage.
November 19 follow-up

Corrected omitted Glaivier core change and unintended Bard gauge generation, Arcanist/Summoner synergy durations, Emperor passive damage and Artist passive effects. Summoner’s unintended duration increases are not counted as permanent buffs.
classes: Gravity Training: damage bonus for Hypergravity basic attacks and Vortex Gravity 7/14/24% → 10/17/28%.

Brand durations: Light Shock 8 → 16s; Sword of Justice 10 → 18s; Holy Explosion 15 → 24s; Godsent Law 12 → 20s. Enlightenment brand 8 → 10s; Sword Prayer core brand 5 → 10s. Wrath of God cooldown 27 → 30s; Heavenly Blessings 36 → 30s. Mana costs 557/657 → 592 each.
Enlightenment: Berserk crit damage 17/34/51% → 19/38/57%; Unstoppable Fury base damage and extra enhanced-Berserk damage each 4/8/12% → 4/8/13%.
Brand durations on 진리의 선고 and 진리의 륜: 5 → 12s and 10 → 16s. Main attack-buff cooldowns 27/36 → 30/30s; mana costs 557/657 → 592 each. Enlightenment brand 7 → 8s.

Taijutsu stamina-skill bonus 40/55/70% → 40/56/73%; Shock Training shock-skill bonus 11/22/33% → 12/24/37%. Two skill tripods (파쇄의 강타, 진 용출권) crit bonus 100 → 80%. Shockwave Sun core 17P: affected skill’s damage bonus 47/50% → 100/104%, removing its +100% crit bonus.

Focus-skill tripods reworked: several guaranteed-crit or high-crit effects become guaranteed crit with +0.6% damage per 1% crit rate. Spear of Destruction variants retain their crit-damage bonus. Thrust of Destruction weak-point detection damage 25/50% → 60/96%; charge variant loses +40% crit. Spiraling Spear (사두룡격) crit tripod 15/40% becomes 30/40.8% damage reduction while casting. Nov 19 correction: Evolution’s End Star core 17P also uses guaranteed crit and +0.6% damage per 1% crit rate; −30% skill damage and Focus damage 0/1% retained.
Asura-related Enlightenment passive (무아지경): damage bonus at ranks 2/3, 8/16% → 9/18% (community cross-check).
Execution and Cruel Tracker crit tripods: 100% → 80% crit bonus (community cross-check).
Napalm Shot crit tripod: 100% → 80%. Enlightenment A.C.T. summon damage bonus 6/12/18% → 7/14/21%; saturation-attack passive 4/10/16% → 5/12/19%, with extra skill-specific 0/30/60% retained.
Evasive Fire crit tripod: +100% → +80% crit rate; +44% crit damage retained.
Core Enchant Enlightenment: damage bonus 5/10/15% → 5/11/17%. Crit rate and battery effects unchanged.
Peacemaker handgun, shotgun and rifle skill damage bonus each 4% → 7%. Rose Blossom maximum stack damage bonus 40/80/120% → 50/100/150%. Death Fire crit tripod 83% → 80%.

Empress-related Ruin damage bonus 6/13/20% → 10/17/25%. Spineflower high-crit tripod capped at 80% (community cross-check). November 19 fixed unintended synergy durations and excessive Mercy of the Emperor rank 5 damage; intended bonus is 6%, not the datamined 27%.

Sonic Vibration buff applies up to 6s from zone creation rather than a 2s refresh. Brand durations: Sound Shock 7 → 14s; Stigma, Note Bundle, Harp and Rhapsody 5 → 12s each; Sonatina 10 → 18s; Enlightenment brand 8 → 10s (community cross-check). Nov 19 fixed unintended excess identity/Hyper Awakening gauge generation.
Reflux Enlightenment non-Awakening skill damage bonus 24/35/47% → 28/39/52%.
Upper Slash tornado crit bonus 50/100% → 40/80%; Blade Burst-related Enlightenment damage bonus 7/14/21% → 8/16/24%.
Fatal Step/Hunger-related passive damage bonus for dagger, shadow and swoop skills plus poison/bleed effects 20/40/60% → 24/45/66%.

Ink-brand durations: 먹물세례 6 → 12s; 난치기 12 → 18s; 호접몽 10 → 18s; Enlightenment brand 6 → 7s. Paint: Sun Well attack-power buff now lasts up to 6s from zone creation (formerly 2s). 먹오름 crit tripod 95% → 80% in PvE, 40% in PvP. Nov 19 restored missing Moon’s Shadow rank 1–4 effects.
Drizzle: Clear Day Enlightenment weather-skill damage while Sun Shower is active 11/23/35% → 14/28/42%. Wind Fury: space-cutting Enlightenment skill (공간 가르기) damage bonus 0/100/200% → 0/130/260%.
All Minute Hand skills, including Ark Passive and Hyper Awakening skills, and Dimension Slash Awakening damage −5%.

Rows identified as community cross-checks have weaker source support. November 19 fixes are included with November 18 rather than counted as a separate major patch. No November 18 numerical modifiers have been added to the direct PvE cumulative totals, since they affect specific passives, skills, crit or mechanics; the combined class history includes them.
